requirements.title: Add task
requirements.text: The system shall let a user add a task with a title.
acceptanceCriteria: A task added with a non-empty title appears in the task list with status open.
Adding a task with an empty title is rejected with an error message.

requirements.title: List tasks
requirements.text: The system shall show all tasks, newest first.
acceptanceCriteria: The list shows every task with its title and status.
Tasks are ordered by creation time, newest first.

requirements.title: Persist tasks
requirements.text: The system shall keep tasks when the server restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks added before a restart are listed after the restart.

requirements.title: Complete task
requirements.text: The system shall let a user mark a task as done.
acceptanceCriteria: A task marked as done is listed with status done.

assumptions: A single user; no login is needed.
